component.name: OpenBox
component.summary: Local-first Linux game library and launcher

description.p: OpenBox is an open-source game library manager and launcher for Linux. It unifies Steam, Heroic, Lutris, ROM collections, and emulator workflows in one local catalog with metadata, artwork, session tracking, and launch orchestration.

Features include Big Box fullscreen browsing, LaunchBox Games Database sync, RetroAchievements integration, save backups, plugin hooks, storefront import tools, custom fields, ESRB filters, list view, drag-and-drop import, bundled media packs, and localized UI strings. LaunchBox Premium-equivalent workflows are included at no cost.
Gameyfin storefront integration with on-demand install and uninstall, owned vs installed library filters, and optional Ludusavi and Hoard save-tool hooks.
Premium parity release with custom fields, ESRB filters, list view, import wizard, bundled media packs, and Big Box polish. All LaunchBox Premium-equivalent workflows are included at no cost.
LaunchBox-depth parity release with storefront catalogs, Big Box polish, integrations, and Linux-first equivalents for storefront and integration workflows.
